metadata.name: SkillBridge current-helper development demonstration
metadata.labeling_protocol: Original synthetic archetype labels; not independently judged.
metadata.note: All 60 cases are familiar development data. No final validation is claimed. Coordinates were not present in this source: all location scores are neutral .5.
metadata.evidence_note: Item outcomes randomly allocated within fixed category totals. No observed responses or independently verified task requirements are supplied. This simulation cannot validate benefit from real question-level evidence.

environment.note: Record RAM/CPU model from the Colab environment cell too. CPU pipelines; no GPU comparison.

results.note: Structured-only removes NLP without changing relative category/location weights. Its scores max at .75; only ranking metrics are compared. Timed work excludes profile generation, category/location construction, model load, data reads, metrics, DB and network. This is a partial warm batch measurement.
